- Start point: open grass, about 40 tiles from the ore area.
- Iron patch: north-west of start, about 15 to 20 tiles. Iron chest sits at its south-east edge. Iron ore tiles are blue-grey rocks.
- Copper patch: directly west of the iron patch. I am standing on it now, near its south-east edge (copper patch is orange rocks). Iron is south-east of me on screen, with iron tiles visible at the bottom-right corner of the screen.
- Stone patch: north-east of the iron patch, beyond the trees (tan rocks, I hand-mined there).

- Main inventory: pistol, 2 stone furnaces (shown as armour-like icon in slot 2 of the character window), 4 stone, 5 coal.
- Cursor may hold 1 wood (I saw a wood item tracking my cursor). Wood is good fuel.
- Quickbar rows 1 and 2 are empty.

a. Pick up the iron ore by hand near the iron patch: hold right mouse on iron tiles for about 20 seconds (about 8 to 10 ore).
b. Place a stone furnace near the iron patch (not on ore). Insert coal and iron ore to smelt iron plates.
c. Craft a burner mining drill: needs 3 gears (6 iron plates), 3 iron plates, and 1 stone furnace. Craft it from the search box.

5. Operating notes
- Keys: E opens character and crafting. M opens the map. Escape or E closes windows. Scroll on the map to zoom out.
- Crafting window: the magnifier at top-right of crafting panel opens search. Type recipe name and click the result to craft. The category tabs are not reliable. Clicking an icon in a category can select a different recipe (I once clicked an iron chest by mistake).
- Hold right mouse on resources to hand-mine (about 2 seconds per ore). Holding right on a tree chops it.
- Left click on an entity opens its GUI. Left mouse hold on a chest opens it, and does not mine it.
- Dragging items from inventory to the quickbar with left_click_drag did not work. Mouse down, move, mouse up works.
- Pressing a number key selects the quickbar slot. Left click then places it, but only if the quickbar slot holds the item. My first attempts placed an iron chest instead of a furnace.
- Mistakes to avoid: sending several actions blind when the state is unclear. Check the inventory after every craft or placement. Don't rely on the minimap for direction.

6. Other players and agreements
- None present. No agreements or unresolved requests.
